caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a lidded jug or pitcher, centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. The jug is rendered in grayscale, using various shades of graphite or pencil, showing careful attention to shading and highlights that suggest a reflective, possibly metallic or ceramic surface. The jug has a wide, rounded body tapering into a narrow base that sits on a small, circular foot. The jug features a large, curved handle attached at the top and bottom of one side, and a small, slightly domed lid with a knob on top. The composition is minimal, with no other objects or decorations around the jug. In the lower left corner, the name "JOHN DANA" is printed or inscribed in small, neat capital letters.
